snippet.title: Trend TV
snippet.description:
Founded in 1995 as a private media outlet in Azerbaijan, Trend News Agency is a news provider from the South Caucasus, Caspian region and the Central Asia.

Analytical reports and feature articles produced by the agency highlight major political, economic, energy developments and financial articles from the countries of coverage.

Trend News Agency operates five news services, including Azerbaijan, English, Russian, Turkish, and Persian. The services produce news from the countries and regions by placing more focus on ongoing events in languages appropriate to the specific audiences.

Trend’s specialized bulletins cover such sectors as politics, business, oil and gas, transport and logistics, finance and banking in Azerbaijan, Turkey, Iran,  Uzbekistan, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan, Kyrgyzstan, and Kazakhstan.

Trend founded in August 2015 the Baku International Policy and Security Network (BIPSN), a non-governmental think tank.

snippet.title: 62ИНФО
snippet.description:
62ИНФО — интернет-СМИ из Рязани и для Рязани. Мы рассказываем о происходящем в городе и области — и в стране, если это напрямую влияет на жизнь в регионе.

Мы не ставим себе задачу скопировать все министерские пресс-релизы и посты городских пабликов «ВКонтакте». Напротив, мы считаем, что информации стало слишком много и задача журналистов теперь — не искать её, а отбирать. Мы пишем только о действительно важном и самом интересном.

Вообще, мы убеждены, что в Рязани можно выпускать не только бесконечные и однотипные новостные ленты, но и материалы других жанров. Репортажи, интервью, очерки, расследования, разборы, фотоистории — то на чём, мы стараемся делать акцент.

Мы верим, что в Рязани хватает интересных людей, интересных мест, интересных событий, и поэтому ищем в первую очередь позитивные истории. Но, конечно, не проходим мимо по-настоящему значимых проблем.

62ИНФО — в Рязани интересно. А с нами — ещё интереснее!

snippet.title: The New Paper
snippet.description:
Local. Vocal. Social.

The New Paper is the second most-read English newspaper in Singapore, after The Straits Times (Nielsen Media Survey, 2008).

The free-sheet is available in the morning 6 days a week, at MRT stations, selected shopping malls, cafes and more!  You can get a copy delivered to homes and workplaces via subscription. Alternatively, read the e-paper through our website, http://www.tnp.sg/ 

Launched on 26 July 1988, The New Paper shines in offering news with sharp angles not seen elsewhere.

snippet.title: Pocket-lint
snippet.description:
Pocket-lint is a digital publication that launched in 2003. We are proud to have become a trusted global authority on consumer tech. Our work has been quoted in marketing materials for the likes of Samsung, Apple, Sky, and LG.

We are focused on consumer tech and gadgets, offering news, in-depth analysis, and buyer's guides for smartphones, smart homes, cameras, and the latest advances in similar technologies.

We have been at the forefront of significant technology shifts, from the rollout of 3G to the first iPhone to the product reveals for all the latest game consoles.

At the heart of Pocket-lint is our editorial team, a group of seasoned consumer tech experts who have dedicated years to the consumer tech space. Their expertise ensures that every article we publish is a reliable source of information, delivering exactly what consumers need to know.

For copyright matters relating to this page, please contact us directly at: legal@valnetinc.com.

snippet.title: New Age BD
snippet.description: This YouTube channel belongs to New Age, a Dhaka-based leading English language daily newspaper, which has come a long way, both in terms of the quality of its contents and reach to an ever-expanding readership since the newspaper first hit newsstands in June 2003. Today, New Age has a distinct presence, both in print and electronic version at home and abroad, consistently displaying the courage of espousing strong and fearless journalistic ethos dedicated to discharging democratically oriented intellectual responsibilities in society by way of providing factual news and presenting views that uphold political, economic and cultural interest of the people of Bangladesh and beyond. And New Age has done the job under all circumstances, during all regimes — political or apolitical — irrespective of their ideological colours while it remains committed to the job in the years to come.
